login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to continue where your workspace left off.
login.feature1: Use password, magic link, or Google sign-in
login.feature2: Keep your canvas and workspace state in one place
login.feature3: Move from idea to delivery without switching tools

register.title: Create a workspace account
register.description: Register with email and password, then come back to the same canvas from any device.
register.feature1: Create a dedicated account with email and password
register.feature2: Return to your workspace after confirming your email
register.feature3: Use the same workspace layout as signed-in users
